rationale: The agent's tool use was mostly efficient: it listed the directory once, read both files once, ran report.py to confirm the bug, fixed inventory.py, and verified the fix. The only inefficiency was a single unnecessary call—running `run_python_file` on `temp.py` with `args: ["check"]` before the file existed, which returned an error and served no purpose. All other calls were well-targeted and purposeful.
